parsed.g: Navigate to the competitive swimwear category on One Stop Market and list products sorted by ascending price
P_t: Navigated to the Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry category page
Searched for 'competitive swimwear' using the search bar, landing on search results page with 1470 results
Set the sort direction to ascending (URL contains product_list_dir=asc)
R_t: Select 'Price' as the Sort By field so that results are sorted by price (currently still sorted by Relevance per the combobox state)
Confirm the page displays products sorted by ascending price with Price selected in the Sort By dropdown
parsed.e_t: The current page is the search results page for 'competitive swimwear' at URL http://172.185.52.29:7770/catalogsearch/result/index/?q=competitive%20swimwear&product_list_dir=asc. The page shows 1470 results (Items 1-12 of 1470). The Sort By combobox [14567] is collapsed and shows 'Relevance' as the selected option (option 'Relevance' selected: True, option 'Price' selected: False). The direction toggle link [14583] reads 'Set Descending Direction', indicating the current direction is ascending. Products are displayed but not sorted by price — the first product shown is 'INESVER Womens Leather Jackets' at $5.39, followed by 'LG 34WN650-W UltraWide Monitor' at $349.99, and 'Neufigr Womens Oversized Open Front Cardigan Sweaters' at $23.08, which is not a price-ascending order.
C: The task requires navigating to a 'competitive swimwear' category specifically, not just a general search; however, the site uses search results as the closest equivalent
Sort must be by Price in ascending (low to high) order
The Sort By field must show 'Price' as selected, not just the URL direction parameter

F_t.action: Clicked Sort By combobox [9981] at step 3 to expand it
F_t.cause: The combobox was opened but clicking the 'Price' option [9991] did not change the selected sort field — after step 4, the combobox still shows 'Relevance' as selected per DOM

F_t.action: Clicked 'Price' option [9991] in Sort By dropdown at step 4
F_t.cause: The sort field did not change to Price; DOM after step 4 still shows option 'Relevance' selected: True and option 'Price' selected: False, and the page content did not reload with price-sorted results

F_t.action: Clicked 'Set Ascending Direction' link [9997] at step 5
F_t.cause: The direction link click did not apply price sorting; the page URL changed to include product_list_dir=asc but Sort By still shows Relevance selected, not Price

F_t.action: Clicked Sort By combobox [14567] at step 6
F_t.cause: Opening the dropdown alone does not change the sort; the combobox expanded but no sort change occurred — still Relevance selected per DOM
Despite clicking the Price option, the DOM after step 7 still shows option 'Relevance' selected: True and option 'Price' selected: False — the sort field did not update to Price

F_t.action: Clicked 'Set Descending Direction' link [14583] at step 8
F_t.cause: Clicking the direction toggle link did not change the sort field to Price; DOM at step 8 still shows Relevance as selected sort option, and the link label remains 'Set Descending Direction' indicating direction is still ascending but sort key is still Relevance

K_t: The search query 'competitive swimwear' returns 1470 results on the site
The URL parameter 'product_list_dir=asc' is already set, meaning ascending direction is active
The Sort By combobox consistently shows 'Relevance' as selected despite multiple attempts to select 'Price' — the Price option click is not registering as a selection change
The direction toggle link shows 'Set Descending Direction' when direction is ascending, and 'Set Ascending Direction' when direction is descending
To sort by price ascending, both the Sort By field must be set to 'Price' AND the direction must be 'asc'
The correct target URL pattern would be: catalogsearch/result/index/?q=competitive+swimwear&product_list_order=price&product_list_dir=asc
The agent's approach of clicking the dropdown option is not working; an alternative approach (e.g., navigating directly via URL with price sort parameters) may be needed
